description: Lands, validates and stages all inbound feeds, tables and API pulls
Refreshes customer, counterparty and KYC reference data
Posts the day's transactions to accounts and the ledger staging area
Accrues interest, applies fees and charges across all products
Computes credit/market risk exposures and scores using EOD prices and curves
Generates settlement and payment instructions for custodians and networks
Screens the day's activity for AML and fraud patterns
Builds regulatory report extracts (FINREP, LCR) from posted data
Renders customer statements and notices for print and e-delivery
Reconciles internal balances against external feeds; emits break reports
Publishes curated data to the warehouse and archives the day's snapshot
